gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Expressive is the first word that comes to mind for Funnel Display, whose spaghetti-like strokes never vary in width. Yet Anek Gurmukhi sits beside it with big open counters and generous curves, and the two feel like a loud voice next to a patient one.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall, its x-height reaching up like a squared-off woodblock letter with terminals stopping far from the stem. Funnel Display's pen line holds one width throughout, so the pair feels commanding yet uncluttered in a way few combinations manage.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-latin: Loose, wiry, and confident. Funnel Display has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet, and Anek Latin follows with tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, so its size can stay modest without losing presence.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps almost no gap between its x-height and the caps, with curve tips that never quite touch. Funnel Display brings an expressive, commanding line with no calligraphic thinning, and that shared clarity is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-odia: Clean and contemporary, Anek Odia keeps its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook, with capitals barely above the lowercase. Funnel Display draws every stroke at a single thickness with no thick and thin, and that steady line is what makes the pair hang together.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads modern and open, with big round lowercase bowls and curves that look half unwrapped. Funnel Display adds a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, so the heading hums along while the plain sans text does the talking.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anek-telugu: Funnel Display draws its round letters like bent wire, expressive and commanding without a single swollen stroke. And Anek Telugu answers with wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds, an approachable plain sans whose friendliness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-anuphan: Round, bright, and uncluttered. Anuphan fills its lowercase with big bowls and open curves, and Funnel Display wraps its counters in one steady thickness, so the sans text feels like a friendly echo of the heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-arimo: Arimo reads tall and spacious, with a high mean line and wide gaps in its rounds. Funnel Display is the showpiece, a marker-traced voice with real command, while Arimo does the quieter work of staying out of its way.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-armata: Armata reads spacious, with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and gaps left open in its rounds. Funnel Display adds uninterrupted monoline strokes with an expressive, commanding edge, and that shared smoothness is the pair's strongest quality.
